title: Add aom CLI surface for local lifecycle
purpose: Expose local-first aom lifecycle commands without creating a second runtime authority.
scope: Add search, show, verify, stage and explain command surfaces.
Keep activate disabled until runtime-mediated activation tasks are complete.
Route command data through AgentCore/resolver contracts.
acceptance_criteria: aom commands do not expose shell.exec.
activate is gated until TASK-ECO-004 and TASK-ECO-005.
agentd does not own resolver logic.
